title: ( XP ) Options Menu with Volume Control

posts.author: Zion
posts.body:
Options Menu with Volume Control
by Zion
​
Introduction
Hello everyone!
I don't work with RPG Maker XP myself, but I have a friend who does. And so far we have not been able to find a script that adds a volume control to XP. Feel free to correct me if there is one.
Anyway, I'm in the process of writing one. So I wanted to ask if there is any demand? Since the XP is really old. How many people still work with the XP?
In the following I'll tell you the features of the script. If you have any questions, please contact me.
Description:
This script creates an options menu that can be accessed from both the title screen and the in-game menu.
It contains the following options:
- Volume Control
Notes:
- Be aware there could be incompabilities with other option scripts.
Screenshots
More info will follow soon.
